`479-481`: ** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Unverified finding** Verification ran but could not confirm this finding. It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Report `tool_calls` only when the stream is complete.** When the first tool-call chunk has `done:false`, this branch still sets `FinishReason` to `"tool_calls"`. The new test supplies exactly that sequence. `FinishReason` denotes why the model stopped, so a client that treats it as the terminal event can stop before the second tool call arrives. Track whether the stream has emitted tool calls, and set the finish reason on the `done` chunk instead. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/looplj/axonhub/743540b25df21aac00d3f3728fd3a984ae098fa1/llm/model.go))
